Door 1. Welcome aboard, {name}. For the next 24 doors, the boat is yours.
Door 2. A small reminder that you are the kind of person people are glad to know.
Door 3. Say yes to one small adventure this week. It does not have to be big.
Door 4. Something warm to drink, something kind to say. Do both today.
Door 5. Think of a morning you loved. Keep it with you today.
Door 6. Lanterns are lit along the water. Someone is thinking of you.
Door 7. Send a message to someone you have not spoken to in a while.
Door 8. You do more good than you notice, {name}.
Door 9. The mist is coming in. A good evening for a long, slow chat.
Door 10. Write down three things that went right this week.
Door 11. Put on your favourite song and let it play all the way through.
Door 12. Halfway there. Take a breath and look at how far you have come.
Door 13. A first thin layer of ice forms at the edges. Quiet is allowed.
Door 14. Share a small joke today. Laughter keeps the cold out.
Door 15. Tidy one small corner of your day, and enjoy the calm.
Door 16. Plan something to look forward to, however small.
Door 17. Snow settles on the thatch. Rest is part of the work.
Door 18. The water is frozen solid and the boat is locked in. You are exactly where you should be.
Door 19. Tell someone what they mean to you, in plain words.
Door 20. Trees push up through the ice. Growth shows up in odd places.
Door 21. Light one more lantern for someone who is far away.
Door 22. Almost there. Notice how much you have enjoyed this.
Door 23. One more door tomorrow. Tonight, just be still for a minute.
Door 24. The star is lit, {name}. Thank you for opening every door.
